named_insureds_shape.notes: Single account.named_insured.* repeatable group. Primary is the row with type=primary.

vehicle_rescrape.notes: Original analysis was naive — only counted top-level fields[]. Field Map's nested tabs structure has 73 vehicle fields across Vehicle/Rating/Coverages tabs. Scraper was fine.

gl_additional_interest.notes: 21 correct AI fields moved from misnamed General Liability > GeneralInfo201404 into General Liability > AdditionalInterest. Misnamed entry deleted. The 27 wrong fields (Products schedule duplicates) confirmed as exact duplicates of General Liability > Products and discarded. Backup at Library/Epic Field Map.json.bak.

address_subfields.notes: Every address gets line_1, line_2, line_3, city, state, zip, country (default US). Decoupled from EPIC UI shape. Missing Field Map entries handled at data-entry time via JIT enrichment.

property_building_bpp.notes: Single policy.property.subject.* schema with coverage_type discriminator (Building | BPP | BI | Extra Expense). Matches EPIC storage. PropertyForm GUI table needs reshape post-Tier-1.

umbrella_underlying.notes: Three singleton sub-blocks (auto/gl/el) + one repeatable (other, EPIC cap 2). 35 tags total. cboGLDedType is the GL coverage type (occurrence/claims-made) field despite misleading internal name. policy_lookup excluded entirely (EPIC search widget, not data). All premiums excluded.

global_premiums.notes: Premium fields excluded everywhere — per-limit AND aggregate. Affects Business Auto > CoverageTN (~30 fields), Worker's Comp, Inland Marine, GL coverages, Commercial AP > Status. If a single 'total policy premium' tag per LOB is wanted later, easy to add.
